srList.sentence: Construction of Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) Network and Screening of Key Genes We uploaded DE mRNAs related to pathological tissue subtypes of UCEC identified in WGCNA to the Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes (STRING, http:string-db.org ) online analysis software to identify the potential relationship between proteins encoded by DE mRNAs.
